en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a town square with a large tree and a stone monument in the center, surrounded by modest multi‑story buildings. One building on the right is a restaurant with large painted signage and a fenced garden in front. A man stands near the monument in the street. Printed captions at the bottom identify the location as Dippoldiswalde and specify Bismarckplatz and its monument.
